Row.Text: Human Start Placement
Choose which continent human players start on.
Game Default
Unmodified game behavior: humans share the Homelands only when they all fit, otherwise they are spread randomly.
Same Continent
All human players start on the same continent. If needed, players are moved from the other continent to make room.
Split Across Continents
Human players are spread as evenly as possible across the continents.
Random
Human players are placed exactly like AI players.
Continents Homeland (Legacy)

A large Homeland and smaller Distant Lands (see the Homeland Share option). The Distant Lands only get players if there are more than the map size's Homeland slots: on a Small map with 4 players, everyone starts on the Homeland.
Continents and Islands (Homeland)
A large Homeland where every player starts, and smaller empty Distant Lands to discover in the Exploration Age, accompanied by islands of varying size.
Homeland Adrien
Like Continents and Islands (Homeland), but with richer continents in the spirit of Pangaea: deeply indented coasts, many islands close to shore and Mediterranean-like inland seas. Terrain by Adrien.
Homeland Share
Share of the land given to the Homeland, where every player starts. The Distant Lands get the rest.
Ocean Between Continents
Width of the ocean between the Homeland and the Distant Lands, as a share of the map width.
Map Scale
Enlarges the map to make room for the Distant Lands: pick the map size for your number of players (Tiny for 4, Small for 6), then scale it up. Land, oceans and continents scale with it.
